questions.answer: Go to Tallin, cross-coutry skiing, trip to Lapland, hiking, eating cinnamon rolls

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: It is quite similar to Denmark in many ways, but Finnish people are more closed and not very willing to talk, especially if you don't know the language.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: They were not very talkative, i did never find out

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: The closedness and strictness of the rules

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Well working public transport and the saunas

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Eat cinamon rolls, the coffee is very strong and eat at UniCafe

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Most exchange students are in their early 20s and most social activities happen in student accommodations.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Attending some classes we dont have at UCHP and have time to read a book

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: The darkness and living away from the social life in the student accommodations. The other exchange students were also very young.
